tags.name: web-grid
tags.description:
GridElement - Custom HTML Element for GridEngine

Extends BlissElement (SSR-safe base + §12.3 registry) and composes
GridEngine for business logic.

Usage:
```html
<web-grid></web-grid>
```

```js
const grid = document.querySelector('web-grid');
grid.items = [...];
grid.columns = [...];
```
---


### **Events:**
 - **row-change** - A cell value was committed (editor, checkbox, paste, new row). `detail`: `{ row, draftRow, rowIndex, field, oldValue, newValue, isValid, validationError }`. Twin: `onRowChange(detail)`.
- **cell-edit-start** - A cell editor opened. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, field }`. Twin: `onCellEditStart(detail)`.
- **cell-edit-cancel** - A cell edit was cancelled. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, field }`. Twin: `onCellEditCancel(detail)`.
- **validation-error** - `validateCallback` rejected a value. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, field, error, source: "edit" | "paste" }`. Twin: `onValidationError(detail)`.
- **focus-change** - The focused row changed. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, oldRowIndex }`. Twin: `onFocusChange(detail)`.
- **row-delete** - The `delete` built-in removed rows (cell menu / row toolbar / Ctrl+Delete) — after the fact; veto it with `beforeActionCallback`. Programmatic `removeRows` / `removeRow` do not fire it. `detail`: `{ rows, rowIndices }` (indices before the removal). Twin: `onRowDelete(detail)`.
- **cell-selection-change** - The selected cell range changed (once per gesture / API call, only on a real change). `detail`: `{ range, cellCount, fields, rows }` — `range.startColIndex` / `endColIndex` are on-screen (visual) positions, not `columns` indices; `fields` = the range’s columns in on-screen order; `rows` = the row objects in the range. Cleared: `{ range: null, cellCount: 0, fields: [], rows: [] }`. Twin: `onCellSelectionChange(detail)`.
- **row-selection-change** - The row selection changed (row-number click / Ctrl / Shift / drag, `selectRow` / `selectRowRange` / `clearSelection`, or cleared by another selection) — once per gesture / API call, only on a real change. `detail`: `{ rows, rowIndices }` (display order). Twin: `onRowSelectionChange(detail)`.
- **column-selection-change** - The column selection changed (header click / Ctrl / Shift / drag, `selectColumn` / `selectColumnRange` / `clearColumnSelection`, or cleared by another selection) — once per gesture / API call, only on a real change. `detail`: `{ fields }` (on-screen order). Twin: `onColumnSelectionChange(detail)`.
- **data-request** - Sort / page / page size changed or more rows are needed (server-side data). `detail`: `{ sort, page, pageSize, trigger, mode, skip }`. Twin: `onDataRequest(detail)`.
- **filter-change** - A column filter changed. `detail`: `{ filters }`. With `filter-mode="server"` the consumer filters. Twin: `onFilterChange(detail)`.
- **column-resize** - A column was resized. `detail`: `{ field, oldWidth, newWidth, allWidths }`. Twin: `onColumnResize(detail)`.
- **column-reorder** - A column was moved. `detail`: `{ field, fromIndex, toIndex, allOrder }`. Twin: `onColumnReorder(detail)`.
- **row-expand** - A tree row was expanded (chevron, keyboard, double-click, `toggleRowExpanded`, `expandRows`; NOT `expandAll` — that fires only `expanded-change`). `detail`: `{ row, path }`. Twin: `onRowExpand(detail)`.
- **row-collapse** - A tree row was collapsed (chevron, keyboard, `toggleRowExpanded`, `collapseRows`; NOT `collapseAll`). `detail`: `{ row, path }`. Twin: `onRowCollapse(detail)`.
- **expanded-change** - The expanded set changed (any expand / collapse, incl. `expandAll` / `collapseAll`) — one event per change, after the row events. `detail`: `{ paths }` = every expanded path (same as `expandedPaths`). Twin: `onExpandedChange(detail)`.
- **row-lock-change** - A row was locked / unlocked by id. `detail`: `{ rowId, row, rowIndex, lockInfo, source }`. Twin: `onRowLockChange(detail)`.
- **cell-paste** - A multi-cell paste finished. `detail`: `{ totalCells, successfulCells, failedCells, skippedCells, newRowsCreated, cellResults, hadHeaders }`. Twin: `onCellPaste(detail)`.
- **action** - A toolbar / menu / shortcut item was activated. `detail`: `action` (built-in name or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source` (`row-toolbar` | `cell-toolbar` | `context-menu` | `header-menu` | `keyboard`), `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`, `dataset`, plus the surface fields (`row` / `rowIndex` / `column` / `field` / `value`, header-menu fields, or range `rows` / `rowIndices`). Fires after the item’s `onClick` and the built-in — a notification after the fact (after `delete` the row is already gone from `items`, after `add` the new row is present, after `move-*` the new order is in place); a throwing built-in is logged and the event still fires. Cancel with `beforeActionCallback`. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.
- **ready** - Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 - **setFilter(field: _string_, value: _string_, options: _{ isSilent?: boolean }_): _void_** - Set (or clear, with `''`) one column filter; fires `filter-change` unless `{ isSilent: true }`.
- **isCellDirty(rowIndex: _number_, field: _string_): _boolean_** - Whether the cell has an unsaved change (a draft value).
- **isRowDirty(rowIndex: _number_): _boolean_** - Whether the row has any unsaved change (a draft).
- **selectRow(rowIndex: _number_, mode: _'replace' | 'toggle' | 'range'_): _void_** - Select a row by display index: `replace` (default) the selection, `toggle` it in / out, or extend a `range` from the anchor. Fires `row-selection-change` on a real change.
- **selectRowRange(fromIndex: _number_, toIndex: _number_): _void_** - Select the rows between two display indices (inclusive). Fires `row-selection-change` on a real change.
- **clearSelection(): _void_** - Clear every selection kind: rows, the cell range and columns.
- **clearRowSelection(): _void_** - Clear only the row selection.
- **isRowSelected(rowIndex: _number_): _boolean_** - Whether the row at this display index is selected.
- **copySelectedRowsToClipboard(): _Promise<boolean>_** - Copy the selected rows (tab-separated) to the clipboard; resolves `false` when nothing was copied.
- **selectCellRange(range: _any_): _void_** - Select a cell range (`{ startRowIndex, endRowIndex, startColIndex, endColIndex }`). Fires `cell-selection-change` on a real change.
- **clearCellSelection(): _void_** - Clear only the cell range selection.
- **getSelectedCells()** - The cells of the selected range, as cell contexts (`row`, `rowIndex`, `column`, `field`, `value`, …).
- **copyCellSelectionToClipboard(): _Promise<boolean>_** - Copy the selected cell range (tab-separated, headers with `shouldCopyWithHeaders`) to the clipboard; resolves `false` when nothing was copied.
- **isPathExpanded(path: _string_): _boolean_** - Whether the tree row with this path is expanded.
- **toggleRowExpanded(path: _string_, options: _ExpandOptions_): _void_** - Expand / collapse one tree row (`row-expand` / `row-collapse` + `expanded-change`).
- **expandRows(paths: _string | string[]_, options: _ExpandOptions_): _void_** - Expand the given tree rows one level, ancestors opening too (`row-expand` per row + `expanded-change`).
- **collapseRows(paths: _string | string[]_, options: _ExpandOptions_): _void_** - Collapse the given tree rows (`row-collapse` per row + `expanded-change`).
- **expandAll(paths: _string | string[] | null_, options: _ExpandOptions_): _void_** - Expand the whole tree (`null`) — or the given rows and everything under them (`expanded-change` only).
- **collapseAll(paths: _string | string[] | null_, options: _ExpandOptions_): _void_** - Collapse the whole tree (`null`) — or the given rows and everything under them (`expanded-change` only).
- **getRowDraft(rowIndex: _number_): _T | undefined_** - The draft (unsaved copy) of the row at this display index, or `undefined`.
- **hasRowDraft(rowIndex: _number_): _boolean_** - Whether the row at this display index has a draft.
- **getDraftRowIndices(): _number[]_** - Display indices of every displayed row with a draft.
- **getDrafts(): _DraftInfo<T>[]_** - Every unsaved draft `{ row, draftRow, changedFields, isValid }` — incl. rows on other
pages, filtered out, or not in the current `items` (drafts are never pruned; they
leave via `replaceRowById`, `discardDraft`, `discardAllDrafts`).
- **discardDraft(row: _T_): _void_** - Drop the draft (and invalid-cell markers) of `row` — the row object, its id-equal copy, or the draft.
- **discardAllDrafts(): _void_** - Drop every draft and invalid-cell marker.
- **isCellInvalid(rowIndex: _number_, field: _string_): _boolean_** - Whether the cell is marked invalid (validation or `invalidCells`).
- **getCellValidationError(rowIndex: _number_, field: _string_): _string | null_** - The validation error of the cell, or `null`.
- **getRowId(row: _T_): _unknown | undefined_** - The row’s id (`getIdCallback`, else `idMember`), or `undefined`.
- **getRowById(id: _unknown_): _T | null_** - The row with this ID (`idMember` / `getIdCallback`), or null.
- **getRowIndex(row: _T_): _number_** - The row's display index (the `rowIndex` of every ctx / event), or -1 when it isn't displayed.
- **isRowLocked(rowOrId: _T | unknown_): _boolean_** - Whether the row (object or id) is locked.
- **getRowLockInfo(rowOrId: _T | unknown_): _RowLock | null_** - The lock info (`RowLock`) of the row (object or id), or `null`.
- **lockRowById(id: _unknown_, lockerInfo: _Partial<RowLock>_): _boolean_** - Lock a row by id from outside (e.g. another user edits it); fires `row-lock-change`. Returns `false` when no row has the id.
- **unlockRowById(id: _unknown_): _boolean_** - Remove an external lock; fires `row-lock-change`. Returns `false` when the row was not locked externally.
- **getExternalLocks(): _Map<unknown, RowLock>_** - Every external lock (`lockRowById`), id → `RowLock`.
- **clearExternalLocks(): _void_** - Remove every external lock.
- **updateRowById(id: _unknown_, newData: _Partial<T>_): _boolean_** - Merge `newData` into the row with this id (e.g. a WebSocket update). Returns `false` when no row has the id.
- **replaceRowById(id: _unknown_, newRow: _T_): _boolean_** - Replace the row with this id by `newRow` (drops its draft). Returns `false` when no row has the id.
- **canEditCell(rowIndex: _number_, field: _string_): _boolean_** - Whether the cell is editable now (grid, column, row, lock and read-only rules).
- **setColumnWidth(field: _string_, width: _string_): _void_** - Set one column’s width (CSS length).
- **setColumnWidths(widths: _ColumnWidthState[]_): _void_** - Set several column widths (`{ field, width }[]` — the `getColumnWidthsState()` format).
- **getColumnWidthsState(): _ColumnWidthState[]_** - The current column widths, `{ field, width }[]` — save it, restore with `setColumnWidths()`.
- **setColumnOrder(order: _ColumnOrderState[]_): _void_** - Set the column order (`{ field, order }[]` — the `getColumnOrderState()` format).
- **getColumnOrderState(): _ColumnOrderState[]_** - The current column order, `{ field, order }[]` — save it, restore with `setColumnOrder()`.
- **focusCell(rowIndex: _number_, colIndex: _number_): _void_** - Programmatically focus a cell. Updates state and focuses the DOM element.
State is updated immediately so pending renders use the correct position.
- **startEditing(rowIndex: _number_, colIndex: _number_): _void_** - Programmatically start editing a cell.
Uses surgical DOM update instead of full re-render.
An edit open on another cell is saved first (Excel: leaving a cell saves; its dropdown
closes) — one cell edits at a time; focus that was in the old editor moves to the new one.
- **scrollToRow(rowIndex: _number_): _Promise<boolean>_** - Scroll the displayed row `rowIndex` into view (centred; the grid itself is brought on
screen too). Resolves `true` once it is in view (after a frame), `false` when the index is
out of range, the row isn't rendered (not built yet) or `beforeScrollCallback` skipped it.
- **openCustomEditor(rowIndex: _number_, colIndex: _number_): _void_** - Custom editor lifecycle — see modules/editing/custom-editor.ts

- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--wg-rem** - Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default 10px, set to 1rem for Pure Admin) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-accent-color** - Editor focus outline, active pagination, sorted column indicator _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-accent-color-hover** - Hover state for Go button in dialogs _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-accent-color-active** - Active/pressed state for accent elements _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-accent-color-light** - Light accent for subtle selected backgrounds _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-text-color-1** - Primary text in cells, headers, toolbar buttons _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-text-color-2** - Row numbers, shortcut help labels, secondary info _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-text-color-3** - Placeholder text, disabled text, empty state message, date trigger _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-text-on-accent** - Text on accent backgrounds (Go button, active pagination) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-main-bg** - Table body, cell backgrounds, filter input background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-elevated-bg** - Header row, striped even rows, shortcut key badges _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-disabled-bg** - Read-only cells, locked rows (the contract's disabled surface) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-disabled-opacity** - Disabled dimming: disabled grid, toolbar / inline action buttons, dropdown options, pagination buttons (→ --base-disabled-opacity, 0.65) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-shadow-color** - Shadow tone for toolbar, dialog, tooltip, frozen-column edge (one tone with pure-admin) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-dropdown-bg** - Floating toolbar background, context menu, dropdown panels _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-border-color** - Table border, cell borders, header bottom, toolbar dividers _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-border-color-hover** - Pagination button border on hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-bg** - Filter input background, editor backgrounds _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-color** - Text color in filter inputs and editors _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-border-color** - Filter / editor input outline color, stronger than --wg-border-color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-border** - Filter input border (1px solid color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-border-hover** - Filter input border on mouse hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-border-focus** - Filter input border when focused (accent color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-input-placeholder-color** - Placeholder text in filter and editor inputs _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-danger-color** - Validation error text, error indicator triangle, delete button _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-danger-bg-light** - Invalid cell background tint, danger button hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-drop-indicator-color** - Column-reorder drop indicator line and arrow (chains --base-drop-target-border-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-hover-bg** - Generic hover background for buttons, rows, cells _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-active-bg** - Generic active/pressed background for buttons _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-dirty-indicator-color** - Dirty-cell corner marker colour (unsaved draft value) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-dirty-indicator-size** - Dirty-cell corner marker size _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-dirty-cell-bg** - Background tint of a cell with an unsaved draft value _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-dirty-row-number-border-color** - Row-number cell border of a row with unsaved drafts _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-font-family** - Font family for all grid text (cells, headers, inputs) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-font-size-base** - Cell text, editor text, dialog labels (14px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-font-size-sm** - Filter input, pagination text, row numbers (12px) _(default: undefined)_

- **--wg-toolbar-label-font-size** - Toolbar button label font size (12px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-toolbar-trigger-color** - Toolbar trigger button (3-dot) default color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-toolbar-trigger-color-hover** - Toolbar trigger button color on hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-toolbar-trigger-bg-hover** - Toolbar trigger button background on hover _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-inline-actions-padding** - Inline actions cell padding _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-inline-actions-gap** - Gap between inline action buttons (2px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-overlay-bg** - Modal overlay background (semi-transparent black) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-dialog-shadow** - Dialog and popup box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-bg** - Tooltip and validation message popup background (dark) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-color** - Tooltip and validation message text color (white) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-width** - Tooltip content width (auto = shrink to fit; content box, padding excluded) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-min-width** - Minimum tooltip content width (0) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-max-width** - Maximum tooltip content width (300px); also caps the shortcuts help overlay _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-arrow-size** - Tooltip arrow dimensions (8px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-padding** - Tooltip content padding _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tooltip-shadow** - Tooltip box shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-bg** - Cell / header menu background (unset → --km-menu-bg → --base-dropdown-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-bg-hover** - Menu item hover / focus background (unset → --km-menu-hover-bg → --base-hover-bg) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-hover-color** - Menu item text color on hover / focus (unset → --km-menu-hover-color; default unchanged) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-text-color** - Menu text color (unset → --km-menu-text-color → --base-text-color-1) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-shortcut-color** - Shortcut hint color (unset → --km-menu-shortcut-color → --base-text-color-3) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-border** - Menu border (unset → --km-menu-border → --base-dropdown-border) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-border-radius** - Menu border radius (unset → --km-menu-border-radius, 4px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-shadow** - Menu box shadow (unset → --km-menu-shadow → --base-dropdown-box-shadow) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-min-width** - Menu minimum width (unset → --km-menu-min-width, 160px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-padding** - Menu padding (unset → --km-menu-padding, 4px 0) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-font-size** - Menu font size (unset → --km-menu-font-size, 14px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-item-padding** - Menu item padding (unset → --km-menu-item-padding, 6px 12px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-item-gap** - Gap between icon, label, shortcut (unset → --km-menu-item-gap, 8px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-toggled-color** - Toggled-on item color, e.g. a visible column in Column Visibility (unset → --km-menu-toggled-color → --base-primary-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-icon-width** - Icon column width (unset → --km-menu-icon-size, 16px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-icon-font-size** - Icon font size (unset → --km-menu-icon-font-size, inherit) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-arrow-font-size** - Submenu arrow font size (unset → --km-menu-arrow-font-size, 0.8em) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-danger-color** - Danger item text color (unset → --km-menu-danger-color → --base-danger-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-danger-bg-hover** - Danger item hover background (unset → --km-menu-danger-hover-bg → --base-danger-bg-subtle) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-divider-color** - Divider line color (unset → --km-menu-divider-color → --base-border-color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-divider-margin** - Divider margin (unset → --km-menu-divider-margin, 4px 0) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-disabled-opacity** - Disabled item opacity (unset → --km-menu-disabled-opacity → --base-disabled-opacity) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-context-menu-z-index** - Menu stacking order (unset → --km-menu-z-index, 10000) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-focus-outline** - Navigate mode focused cell outline (2px solid accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-focus-outline-offset** - Focused cell outline offset (-2px inset) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-focus-bg** - Focused cell background tint _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-focus-border-width** - Focused-cell border width (navigate mode) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-focus-border-color** - Focused-cell border colour (navigate mode) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-selection-bg** - Selected row/column background (15% accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-selection-row-number-bg** - Selected row number cell background (accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-selection-row-number-color** - Selected row number text color (white on accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-selection-border-width** - Border width around selected row/column range (2px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-selection-border-color** - Border color around selected row/column range (accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-row-focus-bg** - Focused row background for master/detail (10% accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-row-focus-row-number-bg** - Focused row number background (30% accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-cell-selection-bg** - Cell range selection background (10% accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-cell-selection-border** - Cell range selection border color (accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-cell-selection-border-width** - Cell range selection border width (2px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-row-locked-bg** - Locked row background color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-row-locked-opacity** - Locked row content opacity (0.7) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-column-bg** - Frozen column cell background _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-header-bg** - Frozen column header background (accent tint) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-column-shadow** - Frozen column drop shadow _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-column-shadow-active** - Enhanced shadow when scrolled past frozen column _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-column-border** - Border on last frozen column (2px solid) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-column-shadow-gradient** - Gradient pseudo-element for frozen column edge _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-frozen-column-shadow-width** - Width of gradient shadow pseudo-element (8px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-resize-handle-width** - Column resize handle hitbox width (12px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-resize-handle-offset** - Resize handle offset from the header cell's right edge (0px — inside the cell; the header clips overflow) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-resize-handle-line-width** - Resize handle visible line width (2px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-resize-handle-color** - Resize handle default color (border color) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-resize-handle-active-color** - Resize handle color when dragging (accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-fill-handle-size** - Fill handle square size at cell corner (8px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-fill-handle-bg** - Fill handle background color _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-fill-handle-border-color** - Fill handle border color (accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-fill-handle-border-width** - Fill handle border width (2px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-fill-range-bg** - Fill range highlight background (15% accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-fill-range-border-color** - Fill range border color (accent) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-transition-fast** - Duration of hover fades, tree chevron, tooltip, pagination (→ --base-duration-fast, 0.1s; 0s = off, reduced motion = 0s) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-transition-normal** - Standard duration (→ --base-duration-normal, 0.15s; 0s = off, reduced motion = 0s) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-easing** - Easing of every transition (→ --base-ease-standard) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-loader-icon** - Loader shape — an SVG used as a mask, drawn in currentColor (→ --base-loader-icon, an arc) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-loader-rotate** - Loader rotation per cycle (→ --base-loader-rotate, 1turn; 0 = the SVG animates itself) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-loader-duration** - Loader cycle (→ --base-loader-duration, 0.8s; reduced motion slows it, never stops) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-loader-size** - Loader size (→ --base-loader-size, 1.25em — scales with text): infinite-scroll row and autocomplete search _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tree-indent** - Tree column indent per level (→ --base-tree-indent × --wg-rem, 16px) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tree-chevron-size** - Tree chevron width / height (also the leaf spacer) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tree-chevron-color** - Tree chevron colour _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-tree-chevron-gap** - Gap between the tree chevron and the cell content _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-dropdown** - Dropdown/combobox popup stacking (9999) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-toolbar** - Floating row toolbar stacking (1000) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-tooltip** - Tooltip stacking - highest layer (10000) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-cell-highlight** - Cell in-range / selection highlight layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-selection-border** - Range / row / column selection border layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-frozen** - Frozen (sticky) columns layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-header** - Sticky header row layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-frozen-header** - Frozen header corner cell layer (sticky both ways) _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-fill-handle-area** - Fill-handle drag area layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-fill-handle** - Fill-handle dot layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-resize-handle** - Column resize handle layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-shortcuts-help** - Keyboard-shortcuts help overlay layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-reorder-indicator** - Column reorder drop indicator layer _(default: undefined)_
- **--wg-z-reorder-ghost** - Column reorder drag ghost layer _(default: undefined)_

attributes.name: enable-filtering
attributes.description: Show the filter row (an input under the header of every column with `isFilterable: true`) and apply `filters`. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: filter-mode
attributes.description:
Who filters the rows. Default: `client`.

- `client` — the grid filters `items` itself
- `server` — the grid does not filter — handle `filter-change` (`{ filters }`) and replace `items`

attributes.name: enable-paging
attributes.description: Split the rows into pages and show the pager. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Rows per page (at least 1). Default: `10`.

attributes.name: pagination-mode
attributes.description:
Who pages the rows. Default: `client`.

- `client` — the grid slices `items` into pages
- `server` — `items` already is the current page — handle `data-request` and set `totalItems`

attributes.name: show-pagination
attributes.description:
When the pager is shown. Default: `true`.

- `true` — always
- `false` — never
- `auto` — hidden while there is at most one page

attributes.name: pagination-position
attributes.description:
Where the pager sits: one area or several `|`-separated ones (`top-right|bottom-right`); any other value is refused. Default: `bottom-center`.

- `top-left` — above the table, left
- `top-center` — above the table, centered
- `top-right` — above the table, right
- `bottom-left` — below the table, left
- `bottom-center` — below the table, centered
- `bottom-right` — below the table, right

attributes.name: pagination-layout
attributes.description:
The pager parts in order, `|`-separated (`first|previous|page-info|next|last`). Default: `page-size|previous|page-info|next`.

- `first` — go to the first page
- `previous` — go one page back
- `page-info` — the "page X of Y" text
- `next` — go one page forward
- `last` — go to the last page
- `page-size` — the rows-per-page selector (options from `pageSizes`)

attributes.name: striped
attributes.description: Alternate the row background colors. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: hoverable
attributes.description: Highlight the row under the pointer. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: table-border-only
attributes.description: Draw the border around the table only, not around the pager / summary areas. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: scrollable
attributes.description: Make the grid its own scroll container, capped at `scrollMaxHeight`. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: scroll-max-height
attributes.description: Max height of the scroll container while `isScrollable` is on — a CSS length; a number means pixels (`240` → `240px`); an invalid length is refused. Default: `100vh`.

attributes.name: enable-editing
attributes.description: Allow editing cells (columns opt in with `isEditable`). Default: `false`.

attributes.name: edit-trigger
attributes.description:
How editing a cell starts (a column’s own `editTrigger` wins). Default: `dblclick`.

- `click` — a single click opens the editor
- `dblclick` — a double click opens the editor
- `button` — an edit button in editable cells (on hover and in the focused cell); F2 / Enter too
- `always` — every editable cell is always an editor
- `navigate` — Excel-like: arrows move the focus, typing starts editing the focused cell

attributes.name: edit-button-icon
attributes.description: Content of the edit button — an HTML string, e.g. ``. Shown in editable cells with `editTrigger: 'button'` (or `column.isEditButtonShown`); its accessible name is `labels.editCell`. Default: `✎`.

attributes.name: edit-start-selection
attributes.description:
Where the caret goes when an editor opens. Default: `mouse-position`.

- `mouse-position` — at the clicked character
- `select-all` — the whole value selected
- `cursor-at-start` — caret before the first character
- `cursor-at-end` — caret after the last character

attributes.name: commit-on-click-away
attributes.description: Clicking another cell while editing commits the value (through `beforeCommitCallback` / `validateCallback`); `false` discards it. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description:
Sets editing / selection defaults in one go; inputs set explicitly in the same batch win. Default: `excel`.

- `read-only` — no editing, a click selects cells; also sets `isReadonly`
- `excel` — editing on, `editTrigger: navigate`, a drag selects a cell range
- `input-matrix` — every cell is always an editor (`editTrigger: always`), Shift+click selects cells, dropdowns open on focus

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Values cannot change (no edit / paste / fill / row add-delete-move); the grid stays focusable, selectable and copyable. Attribute `readonly` — presence decides (`readonly="false"` is still read-only), reflects. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: No interaction at all (not focusable, dimmed). Attribute `disabled` — presence decides, reflects. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: cell-selection-mode
attributes.description:
How a cell range is selected. In every mode but `none`, Shift+Arrow grows / shrinks the range from the focused cell. Default: `click`.

- `none` — no cell-range selection
- `click` — a drag selects; Shift+click extends from the focused cell
- `shift` — Shift+click twice or Shift+drag selects

attributes.name: dropdown-toggle-visibility
attributes.description:
When the ▼ toggle of a dropdown cell is shown (a column’s own setting wins). Default: `always`.

- `always` — in every dropdown cell
- `on-focus` — only in the focused cell

attributes.name: open-dropdown-on-focus
attributes.description: Open a dropdown editor as soon as its cell gets focus. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: open-dropdown-on-enter
attributes.description: Enter on a dropdown cell opens the dropdown (`true`) or moves to the next row (`false`); a column’s own setting wins. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: checkbox-always-editable
attributes.description: Checkbox cells toggle with one click, even in `navigate` mode. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: show-row-numbers
attributes.description: Show the row-number column (a click / Ctrl / Shift / drag on it selects rows). Default: `false`.

attributes.name: show-dirty-indicator
attributes.description: Mark cells with unsaved changes (drafts). Default: `true`.

attributes.name: sticky-row-numbers
attributes.description: Keep the row-number column in place while scrolling horizontally. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: frozen-column-count
attributes.description: Freeze the first N columns while scrolling horizontally (counted after the reorder by `column.isFrozen`). Default: `0`.

attributes.name: show-row-toolbar
attributes.description: Show the row toolbar (`rowToolbar` entries) next to the hovered / focused row. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: toolbar-vertical-align
attributes.description:
Vertical alignment of the row toolbar in the `left` / `right` positions. Default: `bottom`.

- `top` — aligned to the row top (extends upwards)
- `center` — centered on the row
- `bottom` — aligned to the row bottom (extends downwards)

attributes.name: toolbar-horizontal-align
attributes.description:
Horizontal alignment of the row toolbar in the `top` position. Default: `center`.

- `start` — at the start of the row / `toolbarColumn`
- `center` — centered
- `end` — at the end
- `cursor` — at the pointer position

attributes.name: toolbar-trigger
attributes.description:
How the row toolbar opens. Default: `hover`.

- `hover` — on row hover
- `click` — on a click in the row
- `button` — from a trigger button in the row

attributes.name: toolbar-position
attributes.description:
Preferred position of the row toolbar. Default: `auto`.

- `auto` — the side with room
- `left` — left of the row
- `right` — right of the row
- `top` — above the row (see `toolbarHorizontalAlign`, `toolbarColumn`)
- `inline` — inside the row

attributes.name: toolbar-follow-cursor
attributes.description: The row toolbar follows the pointer horizontally. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: cell-toolbar-offset
attributes.description: Horizontal offset of the cell toolbar: a number 0–1 is a fraction of the cell width, a string any CSS length (`2rem`). Default: `0.2`.

attributes.name: context-menu-x-offset
attributes.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the click point. Default: `8`.

attributes.name: context-menu-y-offset
attributes.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the click point. Default: `0`.

attributes.name: show-shortcuts-help
attributes.description: Show the keyboard-shortcuts help icon. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: shortcuts-help-position
attributes.description:
Corner of the keyboard-shortcuts help icon. Default: `top-right`.

- `top-right` — top right corner
- `top-left` — top left corner

attributes.name: column-min-width
attributes.description: Default `min-width` of every column without its own `minWidth` — a CSS length; a number means pixels. Unset = none.

attributes.name: allow-column-reorder
attributes.description: Let the user drag headers to reorder columns. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: sort-mode
attributes.description:
Header-click sorting. Default: `none`.

- `none` — sorting off
- `single` — one sorted column at a time
- `multiple` — several sorted columns (Ctrl+click adds a column)

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Key of the persisted column state (widths / order the user arranged; core SPEC §12.17). Unset / empty = off; set = localStorage `km-state:web-grid:<key>`, or `loadStateCallback` / `saveStateCallback`.

attributes.name: persist-column-widths
attributes.description: Persist the column widths the user resized to (needs `storage-key`).

attributes.name: persist-column-order
attributes.description: Persist the column order the user dragged to (needs `storage-key`).

attributes.name: summary-position
attributes.description:
Where the summary bar (`renderSummaryCallback`) sits: one area or several `|`-separated ones, like `paginationPosition`. Unset = no summary.

- `top-left` — above the table, left
- `top-center` — above the table, centered
- `top-right` — above the table, right
- `bottom-left` — below the table, left
- `bottom-center` — below the table, centered
- `bottom-right` — below the table, right

attributes.name: summary-inline
attributes.description: The summary shares one line with the pager when both sit in the same area. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: enable-virtual-scroll
attributes.description: Render only the visible rows (give the grid a capped height). `true` / `false` force it; unset = automatic from `virtualScrollThreshold` rows. Default: `null` (automatic).

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-threshold
attributes.description: Displayed row count from which automatic virtual scroll (`isVirtualScrollEnabled` unset) turns on. Default: `100`.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-item-height
attributes.description: Fixed row height (px) virtual scroll computes with. Default: `38`.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-overscan
attributes.description: Extra rows rendered above / below the viewport in virtual scroll. Default: `10`.

attributes.name: enable-infinite-scroll
attributes.description: Ask for more rows (`data-request`, `trigger: load-more`) when scrolled near the end, until `hasMoreItems` is `false`. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: infinite-scroll-threshold
attributes.description: Distance (px) from the bottom that triggers the next infinite-scroll load. Default: `100`.

attributes.name: enable-new-row
attributes.description: Experimental: an always-present empty row for entering a new record. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: new-row-position
attributes.description:
Experimental: where the empty new row sits. Default: `bottom`.

- `top` — above the data rows
- `bottom` — below the data rows

attributes.name: new-row-indicator
attributes.description: Experimental: text shown in the row-number cell of the empty new row. Default: `+`.

attributes.name: tree-data-sorted
attributes.description: Tree data: trust the order of `items` (the grid never re-sorts — pair with `data-request` for sort changes); `false` sorts siblings depth-first. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: tree-double-click-behavior
attributes.description:
What a double-click on a tree-column cell does. Default: `none`.

- `none` — nothing tree-specific (editing may start)
- `toggle` — expands / collapses the row

attributes.name: tree-expanded-glyph
attributes.description: HTML / text of the chevron of an expanded tree row. Equal to `treeCollapsedGlyph` → CSS rotates the glyph; different → the glyph is swapped. Default: `▶`.

attributes.name: tree-collapsed-glyph
attributes.description: HTML / text of the chevron of a collapsed tree row. Default: `▶`.

attributes.name: copy-with-headers
attributes.description: Copying a cell range also copies the column headers. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: paste-mode
attributes.description:
How a multi-cell paste treats cells that are not editable. Default: `skip-non-editable`.

- `skip-non-editable` — skips them, pastes the rest
- `all-columns` — pastes into them anyway
- `editable-only` — refuses them (reported as skipped and invalid)

attributes.name: validate-on-paste
attributes.description: Run `validateCallback` on every pasted cell. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: fill-direction
attributes.description:
Fill-handle drag direction for the whole grid; a column’s own `fillDirection` wins. Default: `vertical`.

- `vertical` — fills the source column only
- `all` — also fills across columns

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: UI strings (i18n) — a partial object (JSON attribute `labels`) merged per key over the English defaults: `noData`, `noResults`, `loading`, pager / go-to-row / menu texts, …. Reads back what was assigned.

attributes.name: custom-styles
attributes.description: CSS injected into the grid's shadow root (after the page-wide `window.components['web-grid'].customStyles`); an `@import`ed font is also linked in the document head.

attributes.name: tooltip-show-delay
attributes.description: Delay (ms) before a cell tooltip shows. Default: `200`.

attributes.name: tooltip-hide-delay
attributes.description: Delay (ms) before a cell tooltip hides. Default: `100`.

attributes.name: overlay-group
attributes.description: Scope the "one overlay open at a time" coordination to a named group. Overlays (the cell dropdown, the row toolbar with a click / button trigger, multiselects, datepickers, external popovers) sharing a group dismiss each other when one opens; different groups are independent. Unset = the default (ungrouped) group.

attributes.name: defer
attributes.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

attributes.name: theme-source
attributes.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

attributes.name: motion
attributes.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

attributes.name: responsive
attributes.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on two axes — `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width) and `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket); the breakpoint entry applies first, the device entry over it (device wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.
